name.ja: <ruby>雲海翔竜<rt>クロストリーム</rt></ruby> メルティーヌ

summoning_condition.en: If you have a face-up Sea Serpent Type monster on your field, you can Special Summon this card from your hand to your field in face-up Defense Position.

requirement.en: You have 2 or more face-up Union Monster Cards on your field.

effect.en: Choose 1 face-up WIND Attribute Sea Serpent Type monster on your field. This turn, that monster can attack monsters a number of times, up to [the number of face-up Union Monster Cards on your field].
